check_box.label: Enable sun and moon lens flares
check_box.name: render_lens_flares
check_box.tool_tip: Renders screen-space camera flares for visible, unoccluded sun and moon sources. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Lens flare strength
slider.name: lens_flare_strength
slider.tool_tip: Controls the overall intensity of sun and moon lens flare ghosts. Zero hides them.

button.name: reset_lens_flare_strength
button.tool_tip: Reset lens flare strength to its default value

slider.label: Lens flare saturation
slider.name: lens_flare_saturation
slider.tool_tip: At zero, ghosts use only the current source-light color. At one, they retain their full aperture colors.

button.name: reset_lens_flare_saturation
button.tool_tip: Reset lens flare saturation to its default value
